name: Vegetable Besan Rolls
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: Batter: ½ cup (50 g) besan, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp ajwain, salt, ¾ cup water
½ cup shredded cabbage and 1 carrot, grated
½ tsp cumin and ½ tsp chaat masala
steps: Whisk the batter ingredients into a smooth, thin batter.
Heat a non-stick pan and make 4 thin chillas, cooking each for 2 minutes per side. Keep warm.
Heat the oil, add cumin and onion and cook for 3 minutes. Add the tofu, cabbage, carrot, chaat masala and salt; cook 4 minutes.
Spread chutney on each chilla, add the filling and a squeeze of lemon.
note: The chilla is both wrap and protein source; the tofu filling lifts the total protein to about 19 g.
